user.title: Connect to nibegw
user.description: Enter the address of the ESP32 running the esphome-nibe `nibegw` component — not the heat pump itself. Home Assistant registers itself as a UDP forwarding target and only listens; it never writes to the RS-485 bus.

data_description.host: IP address or hostname of the ESP32 running esphome-nibe.
data_description.port: The nibegw `read_port`, 9999 unless you changed it.

error.cannot_connect: No data arrived from that address. Check the IP and port, and that the device is on the same network.
error.no_valid_frames: The device replied, but nothing it sent parsed as a NibeGW frame. Check that the RS-485 wiring is connected and the UART is configured.
error.no_pump_data: NibeGW frames arrived, but none from bus address 00F5. Only the F1226's internal bus has been tested so far.

abort.already_configured: This nibegw device is already configured.

data_description.push_interval: How often temperatures and pump speeds are written to Home Assistant. The bus itself cycles about once a second; a short interval fills the recorder database quickly. Relay states and the operating mode always update immediately.
